== Acquisition ==

* [[Digo Murkstalker]] ([[Iron Mines of Moladune]])

== Notes ==
*The damage is done by the enchantment and not by the attack.
** [[Blindness]], [[miss]]ing and [[block]]ing cannot prevent the damage from being inflicted.
** [[Flurry]] will increase attack speed without lowering the damage.
* Attacks are initiated but never hit:
** Effects that activate when an enemy is struck by an attack, such as [[Vampiric]] and [[Zealous]] mods and the early ending of [[Feigned Neutrality]] do not trigger.
** No [[adrenaline]] is gained from making an attack.
** Even if a skill description does not specifically mention that it triggers on hit, most attack buffs will not trigger, such as [[Strength of Honor]], [[Warmonger's Weapon]] (and other on-attack [[weapon spells]]), or [[Soul Taker]].
** When using the appropriate weapon type, [[Hundred Blades]] and [[Vow of Strength]] will trigger successfully.
** You cannot score a [[critical hit]].
** [[Fail]]ed attacks such as [[Dagger Attack]]s out of sequence (such as using most [[Dual Attack]]s without an offhand) will not trigger damage.
** [[Dagger Attack]] chain marks will not trigger from attack skills.
*** Dagger attacks that require a chain can still be used if the appropriate marks are already present (from spells that count as [[lead attacks]] or [[off-hand attacks]], or casting Illusionary Weaponry after setting up part of a chain). Notably, this allows dual attacks to be chained until the enemy dies.
*** When used with the correct chain requirements, [[dual attacks]] will [[double strike]], but no additional effects will occur (e.g. [[Death Blossom]] will not hit multiple targets).
** Skills that require an attack (such as [[Empathy]] or [[Clumsiness]]) will still trigger.
** Attack from [[scythe]]s and [[Attack#Skills dealing multiple attacks|attack skills that can deal multiple attacks]] will cause the damage to be inflicted on several foes. Damage will trigger twice on a [[double strike]].
* This is one of the few skills that can damage invulnerable foes (such as the [[Base Defender]]), though this requires an indirect attack such as [[Cyclone Axe]].
* The main spell of an [[IW mesmer]].
{{bug|Similarly to  [["I Am Unstoppable!"]] and [[Mantra of Signets]], the armor provided by this skill is only applied at the end of the [[armor calculation]]. As such, it is not counted in the [[effect stacking#Effect caps|bonus armor cap]] of +25 and is not reduced by [[Armor penetration]].}}

== Trivia ==
* The sword on the [[skill icon]] is a [[Colossal Scimitar]], which was released years later with the introduction of [[Nightfall]].
